moments.title: Chicot State Park
moments.text: Rolling hills ring a 2,000-acre man-made lake here, and the Civilian Conservation Corps did much of the building in the park, which joined the state system in 1939.

moments.title: Washington
moments.text: Steamboats coming up Bayou Courtableau could not turn around at Washington until 1848, when a captain finished a turnaround and made the village an inland port.

moments.title: Opelousas
moments.text: The center of zydeco and the birthplace of Clifton Chenier, Opelousas also spent nine months as Louisiana's capital during the Civil War.
